entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (L0/L1/L2) and session archiving to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory for agents through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text and code. It features automatic routing to handle graph, vector, and code retrieval across multiple agent sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds a knowledge graph with typed edges to store facts with full provenance and support for memory withdrawal. It generates synthesized answers that include citations, gap analysis, and entity relationship mapping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider, this engine sustains sub-300ms recall at high scale using a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents, supporting over 25 LLM providers including local models. The system is accessible via Python and Node.js SDKs and can be deployed through Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream foundation for Hermes self-hosted wrappers, offering a reasoning-first approach that extracts conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with support for local CLI execution and managed hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider treats context as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Designed for Hermes Agents, this zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory operations using only a pure-Python dependency and SQLite. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP and native tool integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a local infrastructure of Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data in the filesystem. It helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local history from over twenty coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across gigabytes of past session data. It prioritizes security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process, allowing users to search months of historical interactions already stored on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent using an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is designed for flexibility, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership and transparency. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and embedding search, with native support for MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to achieve high accuracy in long-term memory benchmarks. It supports real-time ingestion from platforms like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and specific agent hooks, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search to manage memory on the user's hardware.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This SQLite-backed system provides durable long-term memory through a five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search without requiring vector databases or embedding models. The five-package family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference while preserving accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by tagging every retrieved result with a 'why_retrieved' marker and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend, making it suitable for serverless deployments that require self-maintaining memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, integrating with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously recall and evolve persistent information. It preserves citations and temporal memory without vector databases and supports portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models via node-llama-cpp to provide proactive RAG capabilities.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver a purpose-built evidence packet for every agent query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings during tool search operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer manages workflows for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across supported platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using stablecoins across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys for streamlined financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and fetching artifacts while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for state management. It supports pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It features configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, incorporating MinHash deduplication for data integrity.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports message compression with automatic context checkpointing to maintain continuity during long-running agent tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based kit manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of markdown files, utilizing 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting information. It operates without a database, providing five slash commands to capture, recall, and propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It belongs in this list for its ability to enforce test-driven development and YAGNI principles through a plugin architecture compatible with various coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system generates web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with export support for formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4. It is included for its native agent runtime support via DeepSeek Harness and its dedicated CLI support for Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It serves as a comprehensive security knowledge base compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It is essential for visual documentation, offering incremental synchronization that preserves manual layouts via a CLI or MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It provides a master router and connector skills that include verification and dispute resolution layers.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It offers specialized modes for editing in place and supports custom voice profiles for casual, professional, or technical tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution by automating deduplication and quality improvements across sessions. It integrates with Hermes and Claude Code, providing a bilingual dashboard to inspect skills and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library features 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It is designed to maintain session state directly within a project's documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. These skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources, specifically for Pydantic AI. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These workflow skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. The system includes Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service using a Git-based architecture. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes to implement the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on an agent's recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It supports the agentskills.io standard to facilitate localized integrations for Hermes Agent.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports Chainlink services including CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills for FLUX 3 video, supporting both polling and webhook-based workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing and testing while linking instructions directly to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI for installation. It manages recursive dependency resolution and incorporates commerce features using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a YAML-based language and a single Rust binary. The local-first CLI allows users to check, run, and trace task execution across OpenAI and Codex models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, utilizing a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that employs a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub serves as a community platform for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage and offering graceful degradation, it optimizes how Hermes Agent identifies relevant capabilities.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by deploying three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages like Python and Go. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with evidence-based verification gates to ground agent actions. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to agent conversations, providing memory and state drift detection. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure secure local monitoring of agent health.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright scripts. It handles rendering, optimizes files to stay under 8 MB, and embeds the resulting markdown directly into the README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they remain compliant with official frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report specification drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to prevent regressions without requiring external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports automated financial interactions for Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and creating boards, with human approval gating the final 85% payout.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills for extracting structured web data across 31 platforms. It is designed to support Hermes Agent alongside other environments like Cursor and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured briefings containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized Chinese-language tools for video-to-text transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It includes a rule-based engine designed to identify and remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes and other AI coding agents, offering both open-source and unfree licensed binaries. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need consistent access to the latest agent versions and development tools within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing the agent to interact directly with smartphone features.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based installer that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity to both local Ollama instances and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS platforms using Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile hardware.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a high-security deployment option using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced sandboxing. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, governed by configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, featuring a catalog of 69 credentials and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific agent versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates securely with systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix for secret handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It enables hierarchical communication and delegation between agents, alongside enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is optimized for production environments requiring the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles its own Python environment, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes symbols to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It features a browser-based UI for visualizing callers and automatically synchronizes the index whenever file changes occur.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token usage and associated costs across various AI coding agents. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from multiple coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token consumption, costs, and rate limits across more than 36 AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, project, or specific device.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting to streamline the design process.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project functions as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the terminal UI of their agent with community-created themes and ASCII art. It utilizes YAML-based configurations to modify visual elements such as banner colors and spinners.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes native MLOps tools for tasks such as vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports integration with multiple chat platforms, including Slack, Telegram, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve reported token savings of 90-99% during agent workflows. it includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-specific memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that flags vague tool descriptions and missing stop conditions using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs bounded pairwise checks for tool differentiation and integrates with CI workflows through SARIF report generation.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into the Hermes environment. It maps existing credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool provides real-time telemetry for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes plugin that uses passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local execution, this project provides a deterministic zero-network runtime for generating revenue with Hermes Agent. It enforces security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and spending via a bounded JSON/stdin adapter.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds an offline, voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory plugin for Hermes that facilitates multi-dimensional storage and semantic search via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting memory entries.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten communication platforms and supports visual workflows with approval gates. It includes features for scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and profile-aware model selection.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single workspace available as a desktop app, standalone server, or mobile client. It allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent for collaborative coding.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features intelligent tab scoping, group chats, and opt-in browser control via explicit approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent directly from their mobile device. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent chat, scheduled tasks, and server files without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and estimated API costs for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs without uploading telemetry or session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface designed for Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts that enables one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. The workspace integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, provides an interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs with embedded Python and Node.js runtimes, requiring no installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and includes 100 tools for TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers, complemented by an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
